status: nonvertical metadata/schema audit before any point-level vertical values are opened
forbidden_operations: read or summarize height_gener, height.above.msl, height.above.ellipsoid or any numeric vertical field
rank panels by expected vertical individuality
drop panels because of expected vertical outcome

taxonomy_rule.method: query GBIF species/match for every unique species name in the segment table
taxonomy_rule.failure: if taxonomy cannot be resolved, mark TAXONOMY_UNRESOLVED rather than guessing

panel_definition: exact studyID x species when studyID is present, otherwise exact studyName x species
screening_summary: total GPS-point count proxy as sum(totNlocs)
known-taxon overlap with already opened batter sources

structural_priority.candidate_for_point_level_preflight: panel has >=5 unique individuals and >=2 segments for at least 5 individuals in the segment-level table
structural_priority.meaning: necessary screen only; does not guarantee >=50-fix session/common-support eligibility

claim_boundary: This audit establishes candidate bat panels only.
Taxon overlap does not by itself establish source duplication; exact study provenance must be checked before admission.
No point-level vertical value is opened by this audit.
Any point-level RDS handling requires a separately frozen contract.
